svg.title: ERD CampusFolio v1.1
svg.text: Entity Relationship Diagram — CampusFolio (Notasi Crow's Foot v1.1 - Revisi Klien)
• posts: fokus posting foto + teks, dilengkapi audit trail takedown (is_deleted, deleted_by, deleted_at, alasan_hapus)
• user_blocks: mencegah interaksi timbal balik & menyembunyikan profil serta postingan di Dashboard Home
• Dashboard Home terpadu: memadukan feed terkini, friend requests, capaian SKPI terverifikasi, dan antrean review Kaprodi
